payload.title: pinGenesis re-anchors event logs by rewriting them in place with atomicWriteFileWithRegistryLease, bypassing planFindingEvents: a second, non-append write path into findings/** beside the append-only writer
evidence: tools/gates/finding-registry-events.ts:419-427 (reanchor re-chains every line of a log)
payload.rule_violated: CLAUDE.md one owner per concept (MF-DESIGN section 4.1): every write into findings/** is an append that planFindingEvents has admitted
payload.notes: The rewritten lines skip the planner's admission test (row contract, owner rule, state fold) that every other event passes, and they rewrite bytes the append-only invariant otherwise forbids. Once the freeze is on main the branch never runs: pinGenesis re-anchors only when the previous tip differs from the new one, and the segment no longer changes. Read from the code, not probed. Close condition: The re-anchor branch and reanchor are deleted when the landing step they serve ends (the last pre-freeze branch has landed, the condition of PROC-MEDIUM-062), or they go through planFindingEvents. A test that the lines pinGenesis rewrites pass registryDefects.
